subject: Request: temporary extension to backup purge + DPA addendum for Clearwell Health
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena@clearwell.health>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Audit Team <audit@clearwell.health>, legal@clearwell.health
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retention extension request — upcoming regulatory audit

Hi Neha,

We have an unexpected regulatory readiness audit that was scheduled for next month. The auditors are asking for backups and logs covering an 18-month window for certain cardiology workflows. Our current agreement with Redwood lists a standard 180-day purge cadence for snapshots and a 90-day log retention; we need a temporary extension to both while we complete the audit evidence collection.

Specific asks:
- Pause snapshot purge for the Clearwell tenant (tenant id: CLW-88) for an additional 120 days starting asap.
- Extend application and access logs retention by 90 days.
- A written confirmation of the extension and an updated DPA addendum or an email that we can provide to the auditors showing your retention exception and the legal authority to do so.

Attached is the formal audit request and a list of artifacts the auditors need. Please let me know what information you need from our side (e.g., the exact S3 prefixes, team contact, or PO). We appreciate a quick turnaround — auditors want confirmation within 10 business days.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Garcia
Head of Compliance — Clearwell Health
Attachments: clearwell_audit_request.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@clearwell.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention extension request — upcoming regulatory audit

Elena — thanks for flagging this and for the packet. We can support a temporary retention hold, but there are a few moving parts (legal/DPA, subprocessor scope, and the mechanics on our side).

Quick next steps from Redwood:
1) I'll loop in Karthik (legal) and Marissa (ops) to scope the exact objects and whether this is an account-wide hold or a narrower snapshot prefix hold.
2) Please confirm the exact S3 prefixes or dataset identifiers you want preserved and the requested start date for the hold.
3) We typically require a short DPA addendum for retention deviations — either a signed DocuSign addendum or an internal escalation approval for time-limited holds. Karthik will outline options below.

We aim to provide a draft addendum and a provisional operational hold plan within 48 business hours after we receive the S3 prefixes. If you can get that to us today, we'll accelerate.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Customer Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Elena Garcia <elena@clearwell.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention extension request — upcoming regulatory audit

Thanks — looping in a concise legal path. Elena, we can accommodate a temporary retention exception but will need a limited-scope DPA addendum that:
- Identifies the tenant and specific data stores (S3 prefixes, log buckets, snapshot IDs).
- States the duration of the exception (start/end dates) and an automatic sunset clause unless extended by mutual written consent.
- Includes any audit evidence access terms and whether Redwood may provide redacted copies for compliance.
- Confirms no permanent change to Redwood's standard retention policy without a formal amendment.

Operationally, we can:
- Place a non-destructive hold on the specified snapshots and prevent automated purge for up to 180 days for legal/backups;
- Extend log retention by 90 days in our central log store and provide a chain-of-custody export if required for the audit.

Attached is a retention matrix template and a DPA addendum draft. If you can populate the matrix with exact buckets/prefixes, we will:
1) Pre-fill the DPA addendum with the scope and duration;
2) Send a DocuSign packet for signature (link below);
3) Implement a provisional hold once signatures are received or, in urgent cases, upon receipt of a PO + email approval from Clearwell Legal with a follow-up signed addendum within 5 business days.

DocuSign (preliminary): https://docusign.net/sign/ABC123-clearwell-dpa
Retention matrix: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/clearwell-retention-matrix

Attachments: retention_matrix_v2.xlsx, dpa_addendum_template.docx

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@clearwell.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention extension request — upcoming regulatory audit

Elena — looping back with a consolidated plan. Thank you for the quick submission earlier this week.

What Redwood will do:
- Place a provisional hold on snapshots identified for tenant CLW-88 starting 2026-09-05. The provisional hold covers snapshot objects listed in the retention_matrix_v2.xlsx.
- Extend central log retention for the specified streams by 90 days effective immediately once you confirm the bucket names in the matrix.
- We will generate an addendum pre-filled with the scope and duration and send via DocuSign. Please review and sign by 2026-09-10 to make the hold fully contracted. If signed later, the hold will be backdated to 2026-09-05 and will expire per the dates in the addendum.

Attachments included in this thread for completeness: retention_matrix_v2.xlsx, dpa_addendum_template.docx.

Action items for Clearwell:
- Fill in retention_matrix_v2.xlsx with exact S3 buckets/prefixes and return to us by EOD 2026-09-06.
- Confirm a single legal signatory and the email for DocuSign routing.

If you prefer a PO + email escalation instead of DocuSign immediately, we can put the provisional hold in place upon receipt and require the signed addendum within 5 business days thereafter. Let me know which route you prefer.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: retention_matrix_v2.xlsx, dpa_addendum_template.docx
